_entity_notes.org-cemilac: DRDO laboratory, Bengaluru. India's designated military-airworthiness certification authority: type-certifies military aircraft, aero-engines and airborne stores; runs the Regional Centres for Military Airworthiness (RCMAs) co-located with HAL/DRDO/production agencies; works alongside DGAQA (quality assurance). Certified LCA Tejas and numerous airborne systems. Roots in DTD&P(Air) 1955; CEMILAC constituted 1994. Search demand: 152 impressions, avg pos 14 (page 2).
_entity_notes.org-gtre: DRDO laboratory, Bengaluru. India's lead lab for military gas-turbine aero-engine R&D. Developed the Kaveri (GTX-35VS) engine, which fell short of thrust/weight targets and was decoupled from LCA Tejas in 2008; now advancing the 'Dry Kaveri' (~46-49 kN) for the Ghatak UCAV and feeding engine technology toward AMCA (whose ~110 kN engine is pursued via foreign co-development). Search demand: 64 impressions, avg pos 10.7.
_entity_notes.org-csir: Parent body of NAL — included so NAL's member_of edge does not dangle. India's largest civilian R&D organisation. Add a member_of edge to a Ministry of Science & Technology entity only if one exists in the graph.
_entity_notes.org-nal: CSIR-National Aerospace Laboratories, Bengaluru — India's principal CIVILIAN aerospace R&D lab (NOTE: under CSIR, not DRDO). Programmes: SARAS light transport aircraft, HANSA-3/NG trainer, aerospace composites and structures, national wind-tunnel facilities (incl. trisonic/NTAF), and contributions to national aero programmes including AMCA structures. Established 1959. Search demand: 75 impressions ('national aerospace laboratories'), avg pos 32.
_entity_notes.org-aequs: PRIVATE aerospace precision-manufacturing group, Belagavi (Belgaum), Karnataka. Operates India's aerospace SEZ; precision machining, forging, sheet-metal and assembly for global OEMs (Airbus, Boeing, Safran, Collins). Founded 2007 (Aravind Melligeri). PLACEMENT FLAG: Aequs is predominantly CIVIL aerospace — its defence relevance is secondary. Consider whether it belongs in the defence pillar or a broader aerospace/manufacturing surface. No safe defence-graph relationship added (its customers are foreign OEMs not in the graph). Search demand: 71 impressions, avg pos 18.
